QuestInfo.name: [Azmoth Chasm] A Glimpse of Azmoth
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce is waiting near the cleft. Better listen to her account of the events so far.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce says the cleft was discovered a few days ago. The three adventurers who ventured inside have been left traumatized. Go and listen to their stories.
QuestInfo.2: You tried talking to the adventuring party, but they all seem too shaken to elaborate much.

0.0: The Halflinger Expedition was out and about when they heard a deafening roar. Following it to its source, they found the gash in the earth you see here.
0.1: Shortly thereafter, monsters began pouring out. Thankfully, the priests of Leafre--Harmonia, Gritto, Legor, and Samuel--were able to styme the invasion. Hellin then reached out to me for help.
0.2: While we were setting up a base camp, a scouting party of adventurers headed inside. They came running back terrified for their lives. They've been too paralyzed to explain what they saw.
0.3: Given what little we do know, it's clear something dangerous is at play here. But before we can act, we need to understand what we're up against.
0.4: I suggest you speak with the scouting party. They'll be challenging conversations, but I trust you to handle them with care.
0.5: Oh, it slipped my mind, but the party did find the name of this place...

yes.0: You'll find the scouting party around the camp. See if you can learn anything new from them. Information is vital to our hopes of success.

1.0: S-stay away! I don't know anything...
